Subject: Your wrongful termination matter - Complaint No. 2451/2020

Dear Ms. Chauhan,

Thank you for meeting us on 21/06/2021 about your dispute with M/s Goyal Industries. As we understand it, the employee was dismissed without any enquiry. The matter is listed before the Pune Labour Court.

Our advice is to claim reinstatement with full back wages. Please collect the appointment letter, the termination letter and salary slips and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
